title: Which business energy are you bringing today?
intro: Not who you are. Who you are being this week, which is a different question and usually a more useful one.
og_line: Five questions and the version of you that turned up this week.

cta.title: Something a bit more serious
cta.label: The Energy Discovery
cta.blurb: That one was for fun. The Energy Discovery is 48 statements and returns how you actually work across all twelve energies.

questions.q: The first thing you did this morning:

options.a: Made a decision someone was waiting on
Sat with the bigger question for a bit
Opened the thing and started building
Worked out what could not slip today
Cleared for the things that matter
Two long blocks and nothing else
Packed, and I keep adding
Whatever survived the reshuffle

questions.q: Someone asks how it is going.

options.a: Good. Here is what we decided
Ask me in a month
Busy. Really busy
Fine, and I change the subject
Yes or no, today
Where does it sit in two years

questions.q: What would actually help right now?

options.a: Fewer people needing my answer
An afternoon with no interruptions
Two more of me
One thing off the list

results.name: CEO Energy
results.headline: Deciding things and meaning it.
results.body: You are making calls today rather than gathering more input. The calendar bends around you instead of the other way round.
results.cost: Nobody tells you when you are wrong on a week like this.

results.name: Mastermind Energy
results.headline: Three moves ahead of the room.
results.body: You are not doing the work today, you are working out which work is worth doing. Everyone else finds out on Thursday.
results.cost: A plan nobody has heard yet is not a plan, it is a secret.

results.name: Hustle Mode
results.headline: Volume, speed, and no meetings.
results.body: You are shipping. Not deciding, not planning, shipping. The inbox can wait and it knows it.
results.cost: You will be very tired on Friday and unsure exactly what moved.

results.name: Just Trying to Survive
results.headline: Still here, which counts.
results.body: This is a week for keeping the lights on and the promises made. There is no shame in it and everybody has them.
results.cost: Nothing, if it is one week. Something, if it is the fourth in a row.
